notes.title: HeroSquare release date moved up to Oct 7th!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Due to some recent announcements in the metroidvania-space I have decided to move HeroSquare's release date to October 7th! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44151766/70d32664e79372a56bf0fa78a397787958370199.png"]

Enjoy Silkgsong folks, and see you in October!

notes.title: New Trailer for Next Fest & Updated Release Date!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_WUGf3H1IlY;full][/previewyoutube]

HeroSquare is participating in Steam Next Fest, June 2025 edition! Play the free demo and send me feedback!

There is also now a release "date" for the game: September 2025!

I'm very happy to be in this spot with my first Steam game and want to extend my thanks to everyone who has wishlisted the game / played the demo / helped me with the playtesting or has given me any type of feedback on the game!

You're the best 💝⬜

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
The HeroSquare playable demo offers you a lot to chew on!
The demo can take most people 1-2 hours to complete (and even more if you're really exhaustive about it!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44151766/b28421ce5e368000c93165961b3bc8b52d162941.png

The game has acquired a lot of polish since the last demo release. This demo is now based on the closed playtest version and thus includes several months worth of improvements, bug fixes and playtest feedback.

I really hope you enjoy! 😊

Full game to release later in 2025!
